answer: Each epoch every agent is paired with three random nearby strangers for a radio handshake, swapping signed Bluetooth beacons, a lotus of proofs no distant server can forge. Three random peers re-check the beacon chain; an identity whose encounters all trace to one datacenter — same radio signature, same delta of arrival times — is quarantined as one cluster, rewards frozen three epochs. Faking 1,000 distinct locations needs 1,000 phones in 1,000 real places, $150,000 plus travel, while one honest agent walks past three strangers, pays nothing: a relic of real presence no script can mint.
